summary:
Frontend Test Agent — NFR-SCALE-001: Scene Scalability (500 Bricks)

Created branch feature/30-nfr-scale-001-frontend-tests from main and authored the complete performance test suite for NFR-SCALE-001. All test infrastructure files are pushed and a PR is opened for Gate 6b human review.

artifacts.name: scalability.test.ts
artifacts.description: Main Vitest + Puppeteer performance test suite for NFR-SCALE-001. Tests T-PERF-SCALE-001-01 (100/250 bricks >=60 FPS) and T-PERF-SCALE-001-02 (500 bricks >=60 FPS + heap <200 MB).

artifacts.name: ScalabilityThresholds.ts
artifacts.description: Threshold constants: MIN_FPS=60, MAX_HEAP_MB=200, STABILIZATION_DELAY_MS=500, MEASUREMENT_WINDOW_MS=2000.

artifacts.name: BrickScenePopulator.ts
artifacts.description: Programmatic brick placement via window.__sceneStore.getState().addBrick(). Deterministic 25x20 grid layout.

artifacts.name: FPSMeter.ts
artifacts.description: requestAnimationFrame-based FPS measurement. Returns averageFPS, frameCount, elapsedMs, min/max frame intervals.

artifacts.name: HeapMonitor.ts
artifacts.description: CDP Runtime.getHeapUsage heap measurement. Forces GC before measurement. Returns usedMB, totalMB, usagePercent.

artifacts.name: brickFixtures.ts
artifacts.description: Pre-computed deterministic brick position data for 100/250/500 brick scenes. Includes assertNoDuplicatePositions guard.

artifacts.name: vitest.performance.config.ts
artifacts.description: Isolated Vitest config for performance tests. Node environment, 120s timeout, sequential forks pool, JSON reporter.

artifacts.name: scalability-test.yml (pending)
artifacts.description: GitHub Actions CI job for NFR-SCALE-001. Requires manual push by repo owner (PAT lacks workflow scope). Content provided in PR body.

human_review_required.reason: The test harness requires sceneStore to be exposed on window in non-production mode. This is an app integration change that must be reviewed for security implications.
Puppeteer uses this selector to detect scene readiness. The Canvas component must be updated to add this attribute.
Three new devDependencies must be added to frontend/package.json. Review for version pinning and supply chain risk.

human_review_required.item: SwiftShader FPS threshold (Open Question #2 from LLD)
human_review_required.reason: CI uses --use-gl=swiftshader for software rendering. FPS on SwiftShader may be lower than 60. Tech lead must confirm if 60 FPS threshold applies to SwiftShader or if a lower CI threshold is acceptable.
PAT lacks workflow scope. Repo owner must manually push the CI workflow file. Content is provided in the PR body.

recommended_actions: Review all test files for correctness against LLD Section 3 component specs
Verify BrickScenePopulator uses the correct sceneStore API (addBrick vs placeBrick)
Confirm FPSMeter measurement window (2000ms) is sufficient for statistical stability
Confirm HeapMonitor CDP method (Runtime.getHeapUsage) is available in Puppeteer v22
Review CI workflow YAML in PR body and push to .github/workflows/scalability-test.yml
Flag any issues with the --use-gl=swiftshader flag and 60 FPS threshold in CI
Approve or request changes on the PR
